card.name: Inside journal and institution names
card.fires_on: Middle words of proper names of journals and institutions, such as 'University' before 'of Warwick' or 'Research' in 'Geophysical Research Letters'. Also fires on odd split pieces in capitalized label text.

modes.label: Journal and institution names
modes.description: A middle word of a title where the name continues with 'of' or a following word.
modes.example: Now a team led by Dr Robin Allaby from the<< University>> of Warwick have developed a new mathematical model

modes.label: Split capitals in labels
modes.description: A single capital letter or space inside spaced-out or all-caps label text, such as eGFR or a warning heading.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a name or word, and away from trailing ellipses.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a journal or university name, just before the name finishes.
